en: Maybe you could date me. I promise to tell you everything I don't like about you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really!? Oh, but then y'might wind up not liking me anymore.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I really wanna keep you as a friend, Kiryu-san. So let's not do that.<Color:Default>
Maybe you could date me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh? But why?<Color:Default>
We'll be good together. I'm positive I won't dump you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You can't know that. Nobody starts datin' someone with the idea that they're gonna wind up breaking up.<Color:Default>
I'll be different, I promise.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I dunno. I bet you're gonna wind up not liking me and then leaving me like the rest.<Color:Default>
This really is a big deal for you, huh?
It won't work out. If you know you're going to split up when you start dating, it doesn't have to hurt as bad, you know?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Then there's no point in going out at all... Oh, hey, I've got it!<Color:Default>
Got what?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I can dump you before you dump me!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, that's it! I should be the dumper in a relationship once in a while! Hey, Kiryu-san, y'wanna date me?<Color:Default>
So you can dump me? I don't know about that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, Kiryu-san, whatcha usually do for dinner? Do you eat at home, or go out?<Color:Default>
I do my own cooking.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whoa, you can cook!?<Color:Default>
A little bit, yeah. How about you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Me? Oh, I'm a whiz in the kitchen!<Color:Default>
I eat out a lot.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, I kinda figured. Do y'think it's better if a girl knows how to cook?<Color:Default>
Yeah. Not to say I think women have an obligation to cook, of course, but I think it's preferable if they can.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah? Well, I'm a big fan of cookin', myself!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yep. I can make all sortsa things!<Color:Default>
Not really. In this day and age, it's not too expensive to go out to eat instead of cooking every meal.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Aww, okay. It's just, I'm pretty good at cooking and thought that might be appealin' to ya.<Color:Default>
You're a good cook?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yep, I do it all the time!<Color:Default>
What's your signature dish?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Curry!<Color:Default>
Mine too. I used to make curry all the time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Y'don't say? I'm guessing you're into the spicy kind?<Color:Default>
Yeah, spicy. We're talking curry, after all.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh no, I can't handle spicy food.<Color:Default>
Really? Heh, what are you, a little kid?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, no need t'be mean about it. Well, I guess you and I can't enjoy eating curry together, then.<Color:Default>
I guess I'm fine with mild curry as well...
I prefer mild.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whoa, I never woulda guessed! So how come? Can y'not handle the heat?<Color:Default>
No, I'm fine with either. But the kids liked their curry to be mild.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oooh, and you're good with kids, too? The surprises keep on comin'! Hehehe.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oooh, nothin'.<Color:Default>
That's a safe choice.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey now, mister. Don't underestimate me. My curry is like no other curry ya've ever tried before!<Color:Default>
Oh? What makes it different.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Condensed milk.<Color:Default>
Condensed milk?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yep! I put condensed milk in my curry sauce.<Color:Default>
I should try that myself next time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Definitely! Make sure y'let me know whatcha think!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh no, hang on. I feel bad thinking about you making curry and eatin' it all by your lonesome.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I got it! I'll whip up a batch for ya!<Color:Default>
I look forward to trying it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehe. It's wicked tasty, honest. Keep your taste buds at the ready!<Color:Default>
I'll pass. I have a feeling I'll get sick eating that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Sure, I understand your reaction. But I promise it's way better than y'might think!<Color:Default>
But how is mixing something sweet into something spicy going to help?
<Color:255,200,200,255>No, it's good! It makes my curry both mild and sweet!<Color:Default>
I'm guessing the ready-made kind?
<Color:255,200,200,255>What? No! What makes y'say that?<Color:Default>
Anyone can make curry. I figured if someone says that's their signature dish, then, well...
<Color:255,200,200,255>Don't y'dare lump my curry in with them other people's curry!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I was gonna let y'have some of my curry, but not anymore! Not ever, y'hear me!<Color:Default>
Whoa, okay, maybe we should change the subject.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ah! Oww.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I pricked my finger with a needle last night, but I forgot all 'bout it and grabbed this cup a bit too hard.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, it's no big deal. Don't fret over it or nothin'. But thanks for asking!<Color:Default>
That's clumsy of you. Were you just spacing out?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hey, y'don't gotta be so mean about it! Would it kill ya to show a little sympathy?<Color:Default>
What were you doing?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Just a little sewing is all.<Color:Default>
What were you making?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, I wasn't doing anything fancy. I was just tryin' to sew a button onto my pop's coat.<Color:Default>
That's very domestic of you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah. With my mother gone, I'm the one who does all those kinda things now.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why I can cook and sew. Do y'think that makes me a good catch?<Color:Default>
I'd marry you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ahaha! That's takin' it a little too far, Kiryu-san.<Color:Default>
I mean, most guys can't sew even with the right tools in hand. It's definitely a good skill to have, in my opinion.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Y'think so? In that case, I'll try to get even better at it!<Color:Default>
Just don't hurt yourself, okay?
I can do those things too. Don't let it go to your head too much.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh wow, really?<Color:Default>
Yeah. When a guy lives on his own, he has to be able to sew his own buttons back on. I just learned to do it naturally.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I see. You're pretty confident in your skills!<Color:Default>
Well, it's best to be self-reliant.
What else are you good at? I imagine more than just cooking and sewing.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Of course. I'm also pretty good at swimming and driving, too!<Color:Default>
Those aren't exactly domestic skills, though.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, maybe not.<Color:Default>
Maybe when you're having this conversation next time, you should stop at cooking and sewing.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Tch. You're the one who asked, after all.<Color:Default>
I don't know if I believe you. Sewing? Really?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yes, really! Why's that so hard t'believe?<Color:Default>
I just have trouble picturing it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, that's rude. Sorry to burst yer bubble, but ol' Riku-san here's a fine hand at both cookin' and sewin'!<Color:Default>
Did you get it back on okay?
<Color:255,200,200,255>'Course I did! Perfectly! I bet ya got a different opinion of me now, huh?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Y'know, Kiryu-san, I've been havin' a tough time getting you outta my head lately.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Whether I'm here at the club or back home, y'just keep poppin' right on into my thoughts.<Color:Default>
It must be love.
<Color:255,200,200,255>As if.<Color:Default>
I bet I'm right, though.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh yeah? Well, what if y'are, huh?<Color:Default>
I'm just kidding. What's the matter?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Nothing... But you're not wrong.<Color:Default>
Maybe because I'm here a lot. I see you more often than not, after all.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, that's true. That must be why I'm so lonely when you're not around, then.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Kiryu-san, do you like me?<Color:Default>
Yes, of course I do.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really!?<Color:Default>
If I didn't, I wouldn't keep coming here.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But like, you ain't got a wife or nothing, right?<Color:Default>
I'm single. Don't you worry about that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Ah, okay. That is kind of a relief!<Color:Default>
Why's that? If you have something you want to say to me, just come out and say it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Sorry, but I'd just mess stuff up if I said anythin' more, so mum's the word!<Color:Default>
Heh, I see.
That shouldn't matter. You shouldn't meddle in your clients' personal lives.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh. I'm sorry.<Color:Default>
I'm here now. Isn't that enough?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, it's enough. Thanks.<Color:Default>
No. I mean, I have fun spending time with you, but that's not the same as "liking" someone.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hmm, okay. That's kind of a relief.<Color:Default>
A relief?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah. Lately, I've been thinkin' whether our relationship's gonna stay this way or not.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>And so not knowin' where things might be going had me sorta worried, is all. I kinda think it'd be good if things stay the way they are.<Color:Default>
Like I need to say it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Huh?<Color:Default>
I think you already know the answer.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yeah, I guess. I just hope my instincts aren't wrong.<Color:Default>
Don't worry. I'm sure they aren't.

Baseball sure is popular in Fukuoka.
Well, there ain't much else to do, y'know? Otherwise, I don't think folks would go through all the trouble of seeing games at the ball park.
Must be a lot of devoted fans. The streets are always packed before and after a pro game.
Yeah, it seems like it. The roads do get wicked crowded on game day.
When it's like that, it's probably faster to just run where you're goin' than to try and drive.
You may be right. Sometimes you'll be stuck in traffic for minutes at a time without moving.
Yeah, bein' trapped in gridlock out here is enough to make ya pull your hair out.
I doubt that. It's got to be faster to go by car.
No, seriously! Whenever I'm late for my shift, I always run t'get here faster.
Why is the traffic so terrible?
I blame the buses. You don't see many of 'em around when there ain't some big event going on.
As a taxi driver, I definitely get hit pretty hard.
Hehe. Do y'get all riled up, Kiryu-san?
A little. Still, I try not to let it get to me. Nobody wants an accident. I just remind myself traffic is a normal thing and drive safely.
Oooh! That sure sounds like the words of a pro!
A taxi driver's livelihood is dependent on his passengers. Besides, baseball games bring in more business, so I can't complain.
You're so responsible, Kiryu-san.
Not really. Besides, when things are rough, there are side streets you can take. It's not so bad.
Oh wow, really? Where are these shortcuts, anyhow?
Those are a trade secret. If too many people knew about them, they'd be useless.
Aww, ya can't bring up stuff like that and then not tell me!
I get annoyed at my passengers a lot. Especially the kind who keep nagging you to go faster when they can see the road ahead is all backed up.
Oh, I know what y'mean. People who get all ticked off about everything just wind up tickin' off everyone else.
So whaddya do in that sorta situation? I guess you gotta just not listen to 'em?
Most times you just have to humor them. Being told to hurry is one thing, but there's nothing I can do about the traffic itself.
Oh wow, that's awful. It sounds like if a passenger can't keep their cool, that spills over onto you, huh?
That's the world of customer service for you.
I hear that.
I ignore them. I'm a taxi driver, not a chauffeur. I don't need to take orders from my passengers.
But won't that make your passengers angry?
They're free to get out and find another cab if they want. And I'm not shy about telling them.
Whoa, you're pretty hardcore! Maybe I oughta be like that with my own clients from now on!
